job_title: Production Support Engineer - AEM / Adobe Journey Optimizer
job_description:
The Software Development Engineer III is responsible for ensuring the reliability, performance, and overall stability of critical production systems that support customer communications. This role requires strong technical versatility and the ability to quickly adapt to new technologies, troubleshoot complex issues end-to-end, and maintain operational excellence in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities
• Support and maintain large-scale production applications and communication platforms
• Troubleshoot and resolve high-priority production issues end-to-end
• Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term fixes
• Improve system reliability, uptime, automation, and operational efficiency
• Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering and business teams
• Contribute to Agile ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives
• Support customer communication technologies across email, print, and digital delivery channels

Required
• 4+ years of software engineering or production support experience
• Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), or SmartCOMM
• Strong understanding of production support, incident management, and system reliability
